name: Nobsa (Colombia)
description: White field with red and black diagonal stripes at the upper hoist and lower fly corners, charged at the centre with a black eagle rising from flames.
history: Municipal flag of Nobsa, a municipality in the department of Boyacá, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: red and black diagonal stripes at the upper hoist and lower fly corners
diagonal stripes at the corners and the eagle rising from flames
